# Laravel-DDD

> A Laravel toolkit for domain-driven generators, configured layers and discovery. Version 4.0 builds on tey/mod and keeps 3.x behaviour except for the differences in the upgrade guide.

These links target the default branch after 4.0 merges. For a published version, consult the same paths at its release tag and the installed package source.

## README

- [Overview and contents](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md): Package scope and documentation navigation.
- [Installation](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#installation): Requirements, Composer installation, configuration and optional peer dependencies.
- [Quick start](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#quick-start): First generator run and domain syntax.
- [AI-assisted development](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#ai-assisted-development): Optional Boost guideline and skill installation in an application.
- [Available commands](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#available-commands): Generators, configuration utility and cache commands.
- [Advanced usage](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#advanced-usage): Application/custom layers, nesting, namespace overrides and custom object resolution.
- [Customizing stubs](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#customizing-stubs): Stub precedence and publishing options.
- [Domain autoloading and discovery](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#domain-autoloading-and-discovery): Providers, commands, policies, factories, migrations, listeners and exclusions.
- [Custom generators and moving to tey/mod](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#custom-generators-and-moving-to-teymod): The optional move to plain Mod for custom generators and layouts.
- [Autoloading in production](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#autoloading-in-production): Deployment caches, stale recovery and Composer classmap limitations.
- [Configuration file](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#configuration-file): Settings reference and configuration sync.
- [Testing](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#testing): Contributor setup, tests, static analysis and style checks.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#changelog): Release history entry point.
- [Security vulnerabilities](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#security-vulnerabilities): Where to find the reporting policy.
- [Credits](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#credits): Maintainer and contributors.
- [Licence](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/README.md#licence): Licence information.

## Upgrade guides

- [Upgrading](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/UPGRADING.md): Migration instructions for all major versions, including the 3.x to 4.0 compatibility differences.
- [Moving from Laravel-DDD to tey/mod](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/UPGRADING.md#moving-from-laravel-ddd-to-teymod): Preview/apply workflow, preserved customizations and migration blockers.

## Agent guidance

- [Working on the package](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Gates, conventions, compatibility contract and Git/PR rules for this repository.
- [Laravel-DDD development skill](https://github.com/teylabs/laravel-ddd/blob/main/resources/boost/skills/laravel-ddd-development/SKILL.md): Application-facing generators, layers, stubs and discovery guidance shipped with the package.
